newsitem.title: USA: LG&E says Big Rivers reorganization cleared.
newsitem.headline: LG&E says Big Rivers reorganization cleared.

text.p: Big Rivers Electric Corp, a power provider to four cooperatives, and LG&E Energy Corp said on Monday a U.S. Bankruptcy Court approved Big Rivers' reorganization to bring it out of bankruptcy.
The only creditor objecting to the substance of the plan was PacifiCorp, which had its own rival reorganization plan, the companies said.
LG&E Energy will lease Big Rivers' generating assets, subject to regulatory approvals, the companies said.

An LG&E Energy subsidiary will lease the generating assets of Big Rivers for 25 years for annual payments starting at $31.5 million, and will provide power to Big Rivers and their 90,000 customers at reduced rates, while operating and maintaining the power plants.
LG&E Energy will have access to about 1,700 megawatts of low-cost generating capacity to enhance its strategic marketing position, it said.
The final step in the Big Rivers/LG&E Energy partnership is to gain regulatory approval from the Kentucky Public Service Commission and Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, the companies said.

Big Rivers Electric provides power to Henderson Union Electric Cooperative, Green River Electric Corporation, Jackson Purchase Electric Cooperative Corporation and Meade County Rural Electric Cooperative Corporation.
